main_switch2.description: Adds a heater law the device runs itself: with it switched on in Settings, the device holds the set temperature and buzzes only when three readings in a row are within 3 °F. It is off until you turn it on, and with it off the heater works as in build 23. Run in emulation only, never on a device: make the first heat cycles while you watch it. Curves run with the law off.
